# ankerl::unordered_dense

Vendored dependency for Fates' hot hash maps and sets.

- Upstream: https://github.com/martinus/unordered_dense
- Version: v4.8.1
- Commit: `3234af2c03549bc85656bfd3a86993bf1cd8aef1`
- License: MIT, preserved in `LICENSE`
- Vendored files: `include/ankerl/unordered_dense.h`, `include/ankerl/stl.h`, `LICENSE`

Define `FATES_USE_STD_CONTAINERS` to compile the exact same search engine with
`std::unordered_map` and `std::unordered_set` for portability or A/B testing.
